success.description: 4 Name one attribute, such as a characteristic, fatigue, health (wounds), mental health (insanity), purity (corruption), or fortune points. You “steal” 1 of that attribute from target. This effect lasts until the end of the encounter.

chaosStar.description: When the blessing’s effect ends, you lose 1 of that attribute until the next sunset.

sigmarsComet.description: If you stole fatigue, stress, health, or purity, it is permanent.

conservative.requirements: 8 favour, target within medium range Special: When invoke this blessing “steal” from the target, you benefit and your target suffers. For example, if you steal a characteristic such as Agility, your target loses Agility and you gain Agility. If you steal fatigue, you recover fatigue and your target suffers fatigue.
